tasks.title: Establish executable quality harness
acceptanceCriteria: Repository exposes validate and status commands
Controller state and logs are persisted
A boundary check rejects UI/server imports from domain
tasks.notes: Plan: scaffold the executable TypeScript harness, prove the quality gate, then commit it before the first product slice. Verifier findings (2026-08-17): initial checker accepted an empty/missing domain directory and had no negative proof. Remediated with an actual domain module, explicit web/server/storage import detection, and temporary-fixture rejection tests. Post-remediation evidence: npm run validate passed on 2026-08-17 (format, typecheck, build, architecture check, 3 tests). Final verifier PASS after atomic state update. Independent verifier sandbox could not write dist/index.js (TS5033); that environment limitation was not reproduced by the controller validation. Controller evolution (2026-08-17): replaced the logging stub with a standalone Codex CLI loop, persisted active-state and blocker transitions, a bounded-run option, JSONL events, three-failure safety stop, and controller-state acceptance tests. No dependency added.

tasks.title: Create routines with deterministic scheduling
acceptanceCriteria: Daily, weekly, monthly and interval schedules calculate next due dates
tasks.notes: Completed 2026-08-17. Domain slice: daily, weekly, monthly, and positive intervals; immutable completion; pause status; end-of-month and leap-year tests. Browser preview creates routines and displays domain-calculated dates. API tests cover success and invalid/unsupported schedules. Browser evidence: keyboard form navigation plus successful weekly creation of Wipe kitchen counter in Kitchen, displaying next due 2026-08-24, no console errors or failed network requests. Durable post-creation screenshots: `.agent/evidence/HR-002/desktop-routine-created.jpg` (1280x720) and `.agent/evidence/HR-002/mobile-routine-created-390x844.jpg` (390px viewport). Daily schedule correctly hides interval-only control. Harness audit: initial full-page screenshot timeout was retried using standard viewport captures, which succeeded. Fresh verifier PASS; full validation passed (13 tests).
